stories.script: In business. N-vidia's shares briefly hit a record on Friday. They closed just below it, after a slump that wiped out over a trillion dollars.

stories.script: In security. Apple will make it harder for apps to read everything on a Mac. It says A I agents raise the risk, but details are not out yet.
stories.screen: a small glowing laptop with a closed padlock on its screen, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In energy. Oracle's new Wisconsin data center may run partly on nuclear power. State regulators must still approve the deal.
stories.screen: a small glowing atom symbol beside a server rack, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In robotics. The Pentagon may add up to fifty small robot boats on the Rio Grande. Ten already watch for illegal crossings, but nothing is decided.
stories.screen: a small glowing canoe-shaped boat on wavy water lines, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In science. Meta says mathematicians used its chatbot to answer five open math questions. The claim is Meta's own, and other teams reached some of the same answers.
stories.screen: a glowing light bulb beside a small checkmark, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In health. Fewer high-risk patients died at eleven hospitals once A I alerts began. It only compared before and after, so the cause is not proven.
stories.screen: a glowing heartbeat line with a small bell above it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In society. Pope Leo wrote online that telling human art from machine art is becoming urgent. He said algorithms lack the spark of humanity.
stories.screen: a small glowing paintbrush beside an artist's palette, simple text-free symbol

fun.script: And a lighter story. An Airbnb host reportedly billed a guest for a flooded toilet. The photo was A I made, and Google's chatbot found its hidden mark.
fun.screen: a small glowing toilet with water drops beside a magnifying glass, simple text-free symbol

teaser.script: Also in the full report: a market for A I computing power may be coming. Some in the US want to ban chip machine sales to China.

bp.script: And for the bigger picture: A I is now about who gets paid, and at what price. Companies spend less on it, but memory may cost more. Watch whether computing power trading begins.
